Product management approved shortening the label to "Projects" everywhere it

— this is a user-visible string change plus the corresponding documentation
touch-ups.

## High-Level Requirements

| HLR-1 | P2 | The Dashboard navigation and page headings show "Projects" instead of "Data Science Projects". |
| HLR-2 | P2 | Documentation screenshots' captions and references to the old label are updated in the affected topics. |

## Affected Components

- Dashboard

## Out of Scope

- Renaming the underlying Kubernetes resources or CRDs
- Localization string review beyond the changed label

## Open Questions

None.

# Rename "Data Science Projects" navigation label to "Projects"

## Description

This epic delivers the product-approved rename of the "Data Science Projects" label to "Projects" across the Dashboard UI, along with the corresponding incidental documentation touch-ups (captions and references to the old label in affected doc topics). Usability testing showed that users arriving from OpenShift are confused by the longer label, since the same underlying resources are called "projects" there. This is a user-visible string change only — no behavior, routing, or API changes are involved.

## Scope

- Replace the "Data Science Projects" string with "Projects" in the Dashboard navigation and page headings, everywhere the label appears.
- Keep all underlying Kubernetes resources and CRDs unchanged (renaming resources or CRDs is explicitly out of scope).
- Update documentation screenshots' captions and references to the old label in the affected topics, where they fall out of this change (no new documentation content is authored).
- Leave localization strings beyond the changed label unreviewed (out of scope).

## Acceptance Criteria

- Given the Dashboard navigation, when a user views it, then the entry formerly labeled "Data Science Projects" is labeled "Projects".
- Given Dashboard page headings for the projects area, when rendered, then they display "Projects" instead of "Data Science Projects".
- Given the rename is applied, when the Dashboard is exercised, then navigation, routing, and API behavior are unchanged from before the rename.
- Given the rename is applied, then the underlying Kubernetes resources and CRDs retain their existing names.
- Given the affected documentation topics, when reviewed, then captions and references that mentioned the old label now reference "Projects".
- Given localization files, then only the strings for the changed label were touched; no broader localization review occurred.

## HLR Traceability

- **HLR-1** (P2): Dashboard navigation and page headings show "Projects" instead of "Data Science Projects" — covered by the navigation/heading string replacement in Scope and the first three Acceptance Criteria.
- **HLR-2** (P2): Documentation screenshots' captions and references to the old label are updated in the affected topics — covered by the documentation touch-up in Scope and its Acceptance Criterion.
